decisions.reason: Having survived the earlier portfolio pruning and fitting the firm’s core marine cooling know-how, the product would likely be kept unless recent sales or margin feedback fell clearly below aspiration levels.

The compact oil cooler is somewhat more exposed to portfolio rationalization because it is a relatively standard adjacent line, but in a growing firm it still uses existing engineering and service resources well enough to remain on the market.

Finned tubes are more component-like and therefore more vulnerable if standalone returns disappoint, yet organizational slack and their complementarity with the air-cooler business make continued offering more likely than withdrawal.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes match the firm’s R&D-driven improvement strategy and can strengthen the wider installed base, so management would usually continue them unless performance data turned distinctly unfavorable.
